purpose: One fixed alternative-protocol recipe sensitivity check. Historical runs are not replaced.
checkpoint_selection: Maximum full-validation AUC among epoch endpoints; existing runner tolerance: update only if auc > best_auc+1e-6, otherwise earliest.
primary: Per-dataset paired test delta AUC selection minus learned_budget; all six deltas and mean/sample SD, no significance claim.
secondary: Same-checkpoint paired LogLoss, negative favors selection.
test_rule: No test-based selection; automatic single best-checkpoint test per run allowed, no human test inspection until all fixed runs finish.
not_assessed: pure input-map effect at identical state widths
allowed_retry: Identical configuration only for documented infrastructure failure; report numerical failures and incomplete runs.
metadata_portability_note: Public metadata translation/adaptation; arm JSONs are byte-identical to the original frozen plans. Original private plan and manifest hashes are retained as opaque provenance commitments, not a claim that these public metadata bytes existed before training.
human_test_inspection_gate: Both separately frozen queues, all original 12 plus native 6 fits, must complete before any human test inspection or metric analysis.
freeze_chronology: Initial 12 configurations and analysis were frozen before the first new fit.
